name: Continue roleplay scenarios depicting character births
description: Users asked the AI to continue roleplay scenarios, predominantly featuring characters in school or club settings who go into labor or give birth, with the assistant expected to narrate the delivery, the arrival of medical help, or the subsequent emotional reactions. The requests included resolving medical emergencies, depicting the support of friends during the birth, and advancing the plot through specific narrative beats like the discovery of a baby or the arrival of relatives.
